sections.Description:
Players will rock to nine famous Aerosmith hits in the concert arena playfield and embark on an exhilarating pinball experience.

Players score points and finish game objectives to raise the audience’s levels of energy, thrill and enjoyment. Higher scores amplify the experience–the higher the energy level, the bigger and louder the show–resulting in an Aerosmith pinball experience that cannot be matched.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Interactive Mechanical Toy Box: Featuring the 3D sculpted mechanical ball locking toy box that opens and closes featuring an interactive ball throwing magnet and airborne kicker that launches the ball into Jacky’s Toy Box.
- Use the Elevator: Use the Elevator to access the Upper playfield featuring; an Upper Flipper, Orbit with Control Gate Diverter, 5 Targets and Drop shot ramp back to the lower playfield.
- Crank It Up: Crank It Up at the Left Ball Scoop to upgrade any of the 9 Iconic Aerosmith tracks featuring in the game while you play.
